The preservatives which harm our body are called unauthorized food preservatives. Sodium Benzoate, benzoic acid, vinegar and solutions of salt and sugar etc are recommended food preservatives. Ethylene, acetylene etc. are unauthorized food preservatives.

**Industrial Disposal and Environment Pollution**

Industrial disposals pollute the environment. In Bangladesh tannery, paint and pesticide industries dispose different kinds of heavy metal such as chromium (Cr), lead (Pb), mercury (Hg), and cadmium (Cd) as industrial effluent. These heavy metals or effluents enter the soil and water. They also enter the plants that grow on this soil. When we eat fruits from these plants, the heavy metals also enter our body and hurt our kidney and liver. They can even cause death . Again a huge quantity of caustic soda (NaOH) are emitted from soap and detergent factories into the soil and water. If NaOH goes into water, the level of alkaline in water increases. As a result, aquatic animals and plants cannot live in water properly.
